questions.article: Anti-Islam in the Name of Islam
questions.q: Why did the Muslim living in America hesitate to tell anyone his religion?
options: He had changed his religion
Not quite. The article says: The image of Islam had become so negative there.
No one ever asked
Not quite. The article says: The image of Islam had become so negative there.
The image of Islam had become so negative there
